summary: AI-powered app to analyze cryptocurrencies and provide insights for shorting opportunities.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Minimal crypto/short-analysis app logo mark, dark terminal style with neon green/amber accents (crypto-short-logo.dim_512x512.png)
- Simple monochrome app icon symbol suitable for small sizes, terminal style (crypto-short-icon.dim_128x128.png)

existing_features.title: Replace the current “Panda Cards” product UI with a new app focused on analyzing cryptocurrencies for potential short opportunities, using English for all user-facing text.

Create a new analysis workflow UI where a user can (a) enter a crypto identifier (e.g., symbol/name), (b) provide market data as pasted OHLCV rows or CSV text, and (c) run an analysis to produce a short/avoid short recommendation with a transparent score breakdown.

Connect the new frontend workflow to the backend using React Query (new hooks analogous to the existing query patterns), including loading, error, and empty states, and a history view showing previous analyses for the logged-in user.
Add a prominent disclaimer in the UI stating the app provides informational analysis only and is not financial advice.

Adopt a coherent new visual theme appropriate for a crypto analysis tool (avoid the current pink/purple/blue collectible-card aesthetic): a dark ‘trading terminal’ style with neutral grays and neon green/amber accents, consistent typography, and clear information hierarchy.
Generate and include static brand assets for the new app (logo + simple icon) and render them from frontend static assets (not via the backend).

new_feature_requests.summary: Build a new app that uses AI to analyze crypto markets and identify shorting opportunities.
Implement backend data models and endpoints for crypto analysis requests and results, including storing a per-user analysis history (keyed by caller principal) and returning the user’s past analyses.

Implement the “AI analyze” logic as an on-canister heuristic scoring engine (no external LLM): compute common technical indicators from the provided OHLCV series (at minimum RSI and moving averages) and derive a short-opportunity score plus human-readable reasons.

projectName: Replace Panda Cards app with a crypto short-analysis app (heuristic AI)
